_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session B5: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the off-family multilingual control of PREREGISTRATION.md §3, gated; access granted 2026-10-26 and read from the Kaggle secret HF_TOKEN by src/run_hf_gate.py (the run prints '[hf] token: from the Kaggle secret HF_TOKEN'; without it the download fails with 401). (1) exposure_2 on one card: Llama is the third and last control for the strong form of H2e, which now rests on the OKVED 2 feature cell alone: the YandexGPT pair named 28 and 32 of 250 codes against the 3.4% lookup baseline, Mistral-Nemo 12, Qwen2.5-7B 11, its adaptations 10 and 4 (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md Parts VIII-IX). (2) probe and then h1b_rest on the other card: Llama on the canon, for H1 beside the other seven models on identical prompts. Its tokenizer prepends <|begin_of_text|> and does not append an end-of-text token (checked on a byte-identical copy of tokenizer.json, src/price_plan.py TOKENIZER_COPY); the load report must still show appends_eos = false. Planning figures from src/price_plan.py with Llama's own tokenizer, every answer to its budget x 1.15, and, since Llama has never run, the cost of the slowest measured family (12B): exposure_2 7.1 h, probe 1.5 h, h1b_rest 4.3 h. The longer card is 7.1 h; the 8B models measured so far ran at 0.68-0.94 of their figures, and an 8B model priced as a 12B one should come in lower. Both cards load the same 16.1 GB checkpoint, downloaded once; no run frees weights, because the other card may still be using them.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load; the canon is fetched and hash-checked from its registered sources. The Kaggle secret HF_TOKEN must be attached to the notebook
disk: one checkpoint, 16.1 GB, shared by both cards

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: feature completion on the four classifiers and header and row on the rest of exposure_2, the prompts every other model answered; 7.1 h; decides the strong form of H2e on the OKVED 2 feature cell. iris anchors the plan
row completion on the canon; 1.5 h; H1 for the off-family control on the 142 iris prompts every model answered
header, first token and feature on the canon; 4.3 h; queued on the card the probe frees. Needs the T4 x2 accelerator
